sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com) pages and spell lists, read through WebSearch summaries only: the wiki host is not reachable from the build machine (the search summaries name the pages and quote their descriptions).
sources.ja_search: Japanese pages found by WebSearch (ja.wikipedia.org Black Clover article, manga-tantei.com character articles, pixiv encyclopedia, ja.namu.wiki spell list, bclover.jp character files): Japanese spell names and one-line effects, read through search summaries only.
sources.design: Order of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs (the exact chapter or episode of most spells was not confirmed): see docs/magic/character_spells_gold.md.

spells.name: Compass Magic: Useless North
spells.note: Offensive: a large compass needle that pursues its target until it strikes (listed on the wiki's Compass Magic page; a Comic Vine thread gives it to Kivn, the elf she hosts).

spells.name: Compass Magic: Willful Compass
spells.note: Defensive: a large compass appears in front of a target and any incoming attack is redirected in the direction of the needle; close-ranged spells can resist it.

spells.name: Compass Magic: Another Atlas
spells.note: Supplementary: opened from the grimoire, a small compass and a large compass face above an area, the large needle mirroring the small one's spin; it disrupts the mana of the area, dissolving other spells and impeding other people's magic while her own is unaffected.

planned.name: Spells used while possessed by Kivn
planned.note: Her power rises while the elf Kivn possesses her; no separate spell names were found, so nothing is added.

notes: All three wiki spells of Compass Magic already have pages; Compass Rose (the signature page of the mod's book) and the pages of CompassExt were not found in any source for her and stay in the basic Compass book. Mode 0 is Useless North. The order is the mod's design. No new page.
